subject: Post-discovery: scheduling 30-min demo with PayTech
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@paytech.com>, Lily Chen <lily.chen@paytech.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: scheduling 30-min demo with PayTech

Thanks again for the call this morning — great conversation and appreciate the context on transaction volumes and the two latency-sensitive paths you mentioned. As discussed, next step is a 30-min demo/overview focused on how Redwood can: (1) reduce per-token cost with caching and batching, (2) meet latency SLOs with our routing and dedicated pools, and (3) options for private deployment.

Would you and Lily be available for a 30-min intro demo next week? Proposed slots (all PT):
- Mon Mar 15, 10:00–10:30 AM PT
- Tue Mar 16, 2:00–2:30 PM PT
- Wed Mar 17, 9:00–9:30 AM PT

Vanessa (Solutions Engineer) and I will attend — Vanessa will cover the technical demo. If there are other stakeholders (CTO/Platform) who should join, let us know and we can include a short agenda for them. I attached a 1‑page post-discovery summary for reference.

Attachement: post-discovery-notes.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

Next steps: pick the slot that works best and we'll send a calendar invite + Zoom.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0172

From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@paytech.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Lily Chen <lily.chen@paytech.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: scheduling 30-min demo with PayTech

Thanks Jasmine — that sounds good. Quick note: our CTO Raj Patel would like to sit in for the technical bits if possible. He’s fairly booked next week but is available Fri Mar 19 in the morning. From the options you listed, Tue Mar 16 at 2:00–2:30 PM PT looks best for Lily and me, but if Raj absolutely needs to attend we could do Fri Mar 19, 10:00–10:30 AM PT (we can confirm his calendar tomorrow).

Either way, please include the agenda items: demo of caching/KV behavior, expected latency at our scale, and deployment options (hosted vs private).

—Amit
Amit Shah
Director, Platform Engineering | PayTech
amit.shah@paytech.com

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@paytech.com>, Lily Chen <lily.chen@paytech.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: scheduling 30-min demo with PayTech

Thanks Amit — appreciate the heads up on Raj. We can absolutely add a short section for him. To keep things moving, can you confirm if Tue Mar 16, 2:00–2:30 PM PT works for Raj as well? If not, we’ll hold Tue for Lily/Amit and offer Fri Mar 19, 10:00–10:30 AM PT as an alternative that includes Raj.

If Tue works, attendees from our side will be: Vanessa (solutions engineer, technical demo) and me (product fit and next steps). If we switch to Fri to include Raj, we’ll note the CTO-focused items up front.

I’ll put both slots on hold tentatively (no video yet) and send a formal invite once you confirm final attendee list. Also — any specific integration questions (S3 retention, KMS/HSM, VPC peering) you want us to cover so Vanessa can prepare?

Best,
Jasmine
